questions.question: Why does `x.mean(axis=0)` return two values?
options: It preserves the two feature columns while reducing observations
questions.explanation: Axis \(0\) is the observation axis. Reducing it leaves one statistic for each feature column.
optionFeedback: A row average reduces axis one. Here axis zero combines observations at the same feature position. Trace the column sums by hand.
Axis \(0\) is the observation axis. Reducing it leaves one statistic for each feature column.
The number two comes from this input having two feature columns. Add a third column and the same reduction returns three means.
